ValidationRule.description: Ensures target equity, bond, and cash allocations add up to 100%.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TargetEquityPct__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TargetBondPct__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TargetCashPct__c)), ROUND(TargetEquityPct__c + TargetBondPct__c + TargetCashPct__c, 2) <> 100 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Target allocations must add up to 100%. Current total: {0}%
